frontmatter.name: wp-playground
frontmatter.description: Use as the WordPress Playground routing wrapper for ambiguous Playground work, local CLI runs with @wp-playground/cli, playground.wordpress.net share links, browser previews, snapshots, mounts, version switching, and Xdebug. For Blueprint JSON authoring or review, use the blueprint skill directly.
frontmatter.compatibility: Targets WordPress 7.0+, PHP 7.4.0+. Playground CLI requires Node.js 20.18+; runs WordPress in WebAssembly with SQLite.
